verdict.rationale: YYLO supports session continuation via `yy continue SESSION_ID` and captured sessions rather than reconstructing from tmux scrollback, which implies some ability to resume/redirect an in-progress task from the terminal, but there is no evidence of editor or browser-based takeover, no interactive mid-task steering UI, and no mention of pausing/redirecting a running agent versus just resuming a completed/paused session. missing for 10: editor integration, browser integration, live mid-task redirection/interruption controls, evidence of an actual takeover workflow beyond session resumption.
